items.title: 在玩了《无限日记 3.0》四个小时后，其中的新城市和新服装只是值得重玩的一些新增内容
items.summary: The new 3.0 update has tons of new stuff to explore including new locations, outfits and gameplay systems, alt

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/26/infinity-nikki-3-0-1795691870186.jpg

When Infinity Nikki first launched in 2024, it introduced players around the world to the dress-up world of mobile game star Nikki in her first 3D console/PC adventure, an open world filled with wholesome fun, fashion and friendship. 2025’s V2.0 update introduced a new area to the world of Miraland, as well as new ways to traverse it. But now with the new V3.0 update titled Of Yesterday and Tomorrow, Nikki’s wonderful world has been expanded significantly – with its richest locations yet, and even a cute convertible to traverse it with.

To give you an idea of how huge this update is, I played for over four hours at developer Infold’s Shanghai office, focusing mainly on story content and with only the slightest bit of open-world exploration and lifestyle simulation gameplay, and didn't even see all of one of its two new cities. The golden path apparently offers some nine hours of story content, with two dense and exciting new areas to get lost in. Between the V3.0 launch and Nikki’s birthday celebration campaign, players can get 160 free draws and 19 new sets of clothing.

I spent most of my time in Cicia, a city of art, based loosely on Paris among other places, and lined with cobblestone streets and beatific brickwork architecture. Cicia was previously featured as a location in the mobile game Shining Nikki, and makes its 3D debut here. It’s a world where art nouveau, belle epoque and art deco collide, and home to the Cicia Art Academy where Miraland’s most promising students are taught lessons of art creation and appraisal by the finest tutors. When Nikki receives an invitation to study there, she and her catlike companion Momo embark on a new adventure of aesthetic discovery. But is everything at the academy truly as it seems?

Some of the outfits in the update grant Nikki new skills. Unlock and craft the preppy four-star Leaping Breeze outfit to gain a higher double-jump and airborne dash abilities, while the much darker and sexier Night’s Hidden Side outfit allows Nikki to “bind” with objects around the environment (think Mario’s possession skill in Mario Odyssey) and use them to warp to hard-to-reach places. These new skills allow for a new level of verticality in Cicia’s map and dungeons, helping you explore the castle spires or negotiate intricate dungeon maps.
You can also find a musket for long-range attacks (which is a new Whimtech item), and dress for the occasion in Cicia’s three-star, nine-piece outfit Song of Endless Youth.

V3.0 also introduces a new outfit category, Star Crown Resonance. The Star Crown Resonance outfit named Where Stars Shine Again comes with a musket and staff, and is designed for tougher combat situations. With either weapon equipped, Nikki’s unused dashes are stored, and you can release them all at once or use them one at a time, creating a sort of combo system that deals more damage.

While previous Infinity Nikki maps tended towards countryside locations, Cicia is a bustling city. Arriving by airship to take in the stunning views, Nikki and Momo step into a throng of students, teachers and residents, each with voiced dialogue to idly eavesdrop on as they prepare for a huge school festival, building an air of excitement as Nikki starts academy life. In this maelstrom of culture, recruiters for the drama club and literature club compete for Nikki’s attention.

And then she meets Béatrice Laviolette. A young ducal heiress, at first Béatrice is quite brusque, standoffish and snobby. It started to feel like meeting Glinda in the heightened magical environs of Shiz University, and when it was announced in a cutscene that the students would compete for the right to wear a legendary Miracle Outfit, I assumed Nikki and Béatrice were heading into a bitter rivalry. But Nikki has always been a relentlessly positive character, with a deep and forgiving heart and a desire to encourage those around her. Without wanting to spoil anything, let’s just say that she, Béatrice and earnest classmate Déphine Garnier foster a relationship that may surprise you.

Meanwhile, fellow student Sikong Ran invites Nikki to join his Society of Whispers and Wonders, a supernatural-obsessed group who study things that go boo in the night – lending more than a little taste of Wednesday or Riverdale high-school mystery.

Exploring the city is a reward unto itself. Rich and bustling with life, it features picturesque sunsets, glittering lakes, colourful flowerbeds, gargling fountains. It is filled with side missions and simple minigames, including one where you construct a street band to perform jolly jazz music in the castle plaza. In the streets, teachers guide students through artistic concepts that are interesting to read – for example, did you know that in music, technical perfection is no match for the heart of the musician? The characters you meet are endearing; and as before, the dialogue is filled with gentle humour – not least the central relationship between Nikki and Momo, which remains as heartwarming as ever.

But as you progress, Nikki learns that behind the magic of this idyllic city, there is a dark secret. Using her new binding skill to unravel environmental puzzles, she is drawn into a conspiracy that only Nikki can solve.

As part of this, I got to play through one of two new dungeons, titled The Ideal City. This is a clockwork house of tricks that recalls the steampunk-coded vibe of earlier Infinity Nikki dungeons, with huge cogs that alter the mechanical environments as they turn, and wooden theatre dioramas folding in and out of view in the background as you progress.

Half of the exploration takes the form of platforming action, which, like previous Infinity Nikki dungeons, is not exactly a tough challenge, but enough to make use of Nikki’s new jump and dash abilities and test your reactions a little. The other half is made up of environmental puzzles that use Nikki’s new bind ability, tasking you with scanning the area of objects to possess and manipulate in order to progress – for example, turning keys or bouncing between bird-shaped statues on high-up ledges. In one section, you even possess a giant glass marble and manoeuvre it along tight, narrow ledges, like Super Monkey Ball. The variety of gameplay on offer is strong, and, combined with the fantastic art design and hummable jazzy soundtrack, makes up for the lack of a tougher challenge.

Speaking of which, I also got to try a boss battle from later in the campaign, making use of Nikki’s battle-ready Where Stars Shine Again outfit for more powerful combos. I was able to beat the boss on my first try. But Infinity Nikki isn’t really supposed to be a hardcore action experience, and the drama of the scene and the story beats that lead up to it should satisfy fans, while offering some mild challenge to younger players.

Also in Cicia, I got to try the new driving system. Up until now, Nikki has largely travelled on foot or by bicycle, but now she has a range of vehicles to choose from – and fun ways to use them. You can get your own convertible, pay in-game currency to rent a classic car, and unlock even more. While driving, you can change the radio stations like in GTA, engage in Uber-style mini-missions like in Crazy Taxi, or simply drive to your destination. The car even has a jump button.

items.title: “暴雪我在看着你”：《流放之路 2》老板批评游戏公告“真的很糟糕”，这些公告直到最后才透露最有趣的细节
items.summary: Grinding Gear Games' Jonathan Rogers urges devs to lead with their best stuff.

content.v: Every few months, Grinding Gear Games resurfaces with livestreams to showcase all the new toys in the latest updates for Path of Exile 1 and 2. They play out quite differently from your usual game announcements, cutting straight to showing new gameplay features ahead of any preamble.

According to Path of Exile co-game director Jonathan Rogers, this is a key part of Path of Exile's success over the last 13 years. Speaking at games industry conference DevGAMM FTW! , he explained how GGG came up with a winning formula for PoE's seasonal update schedule.

The announcement streams aren't just marketing, he explained, they help dictate what kinds of things the team should focus on with every update. If it doesn't sound exciting enough to rally players around a new league, it doesn't get made.

After a teaser trailer reveals the theme and title of the league a few weeks before the full announcement, the stream dives right into the juiciest details—an approach that Rogers believes is paramount when it comes to selling the update.
Rogers says he's seen some "truly terrible livestreams for game announcements," before slipping in a quick jab: "Blizzard I'm looking at you."

I've watched enough Diablo 4 new season streams to know exactly what he's talking about even if I don't quite agree that it's strictly a bad way to do it. Blizzard typically likes to lead with some introductions before having individual developers break down what's coming in an update.

Admittedly, these can drag on for too long, especially if you don't particularly care about percentage changes to some item or stat. But I appreciate hearing the thought process behind each decision from the people responsible for that aspect of the game. In a time when certain very vocal segments of the audience prefer to think of studios as machines, it's a good way to remind people that real human beings are behind it all.

That said, I think Rogers' specific point about too many studios wasting everyone's time by holding the best announcements for last is often true. For something like a new update to an ongoing game, everyone is watching to find out why this one is worth logging back in for. I want to see the standout details so I don't feel like I wasted 45 minutes for something I'm not that into.

Sometimes I do like the build-up and eventual payoff for a big reveal, though, like the way Blizzard dropped Diablo 5 at the end of the Diablo portion of this year's BlizzCon or how Larian surprised everyone with Divinity last year. Certain games earn the theatrics. If anything, Rogers' approach just underlines how important it is for studios to read the room and craft their announcements around the things that will actually spark interest rather than putting everyone to sleep.

items.title: 《战争黎明 4》的战役根据您的选择而有所不同：“您选择的角色以及您与他们一起做出的决定会导致重叠故事的不同体验”
items.summary: Dawn of War 4 writer John French lays out how it works.

content.v: The original Dawn of War's Winter Assault expansion added campaigns that let you play two factions at once, with different final missions based on which one you triumphed with. Dawn of War 2's campaign was even more player-led, with distress calls that had different outcomes based on what you prioritized and, in the Chaos Rising expansion, a morality mechanic with Corruption and Redemption points. It even chose a different character to be a traitor based on who gained the most Corruption by the story's end.

I asked John French, Dawn of War 4's writer and a Warhammer novelist, whether Dawn of War 4 would follow this noble tradition by having player decisions alter the plot. "The player's decisions very much change the perspectives that they'll experience the game from," he replied. "So, depending on which heroes from each faction they choose, they'll have a very different experience of the game, in that they'll see different parts of the story and sometimes different views on the same events."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CQBCg4rAKeyadRfz8acsyW-1920-80.jpg

Based on what we've seen of the Ork and Adeptus Mechanicus campaigns, that means partway through you'll be presented with a choice between two Commanders who have opposed goals and the one you pick will lead to missions with different objectives. Ork Beastboss Guzcutta is trying to unite his clan, the Snakebites, while his rival warboss, Gorgutz, is an off-world interloper trying to rebuild his damaged invasion force.

"With characters like Gorgutz and Guzcutta," French explained, "it can be as simple as one of them wants to do it the traditional, brutal ork way, and one of them wants to do it in a brutal but cunning way, so you have missions that focus on getting lots of shiny kit in one, while the other tries to get as many orks to follow them as possible.

"In a more complex narrative, like the Adeptus Mechanicus campaign, Potentia-Delta-9's main drive is the quest for knowledge, and she is on a very different path from Skitarii Marshal Sek-Ix-23, who is very much about enforcing the orthodoxy. The story for both overlaps, but which character you choose and what decisions you make with them lead down different experiences of an overlapping story."

Writing an RTS isn't all about plotting out the campaign missions. The Dawn of War games are legendary for their unit barks, like the saber-rattling Lord Commissar who shouts, from the top of an armored Chimera transport, "Drive me closer, I want to hit them with my sword!" Getting across so much personality in a short space is a real skill.

"You can do an awful lot with just a couple of words like 'More dakka!'," French said, "that tells you a huge amount about the orks on its own. Even with factions like the necrons, the way that the lower ranks respond to the higher ones with just 'Obedience,' one word, tells how their faction works."

Part of the appeal of Warhammer is the berserk variety of its armies, each with its own highly thematic identity. You walk into a shop and see the stoic space marines alongside spiky Chaos daemons and units of Astra Militarum who look like they stepped out of a trench in World War I before being given laser rifles.

"Dawn of War 4 is deeply Warhammer in that way because it's got all of these different textures of factions and characters next to each other," French said. "You have orks, and they are absolutely fixated on smashing everything they can in the pursuit of trying to have an even bigger fight. Then you've got the Adeptus Mechanicus, who revere machines as holy and worship the machine as god with complete sincerity and total conviction. Those two things literally exist side by side, along with alien races who have made themselves immortal by creating metal bodies with hyper advanced technology. And all of these different types of character come into conflict on one planet cut off in a sea of night—that's very Warhammer."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5tDdeNcdfHKbJhxDhCGmqU-1920-80.jpg
Dawn of War 4 is due out on December 3 and will be available on Steam . Owners of the Commander Edition will get advance access and can play from November 30.

items.title: 微软的 Github 发布了一条消息，庆祝将 PlayStation 5 版《侠盗猎车手 6》移植到 PC 上，但很快又将其删除
items.summary: Guess who just got yelled at?

content.v: Microsoft-owned developer platform Github stepped in it earlier today when it posted a message on X celebrating the success of AnyPS5, an open source project that aims to let users port PS5 executables to PC, and then linked that success directly to efforts to port Grand Theft Auto 6 to PC. The message was deleted shortly after it was posted, but not before it was widely noticed and called out for being a very bad idea.
"GTA 6 is finally here, sparking one of the biggest weeks in gaming and open source on Github," the message stated (via Kotaku ).

"The repo AnyPS5 has passed 58K stars since its August launch, rewriting PS5 executables to run on Windows and Linux. Does changing where games run cross a legal line? Share your take. Happy GTA VImas!"

Lest there be any misunderstanding, a video that accompanied the post made the GTA 6 connection explicit: "The project rewrites a game's executable so Windows and Linux can run it directly. Performance seems to be the main issue for users wanting to run GTA 6, with one contributor telling the project's community to 'lock in and get your agents to help' if they need to."
And here's the accompanying video from @github's GTA6 tweet https://t.co/crU9cpOWcs November 26, 2026

The question of whether or not this sort of thing crosses a legal line has, predictably, sparked debate among those who think they have a clear understanding of the answer. What caught most by surprise, though, is that Github—which is owned by Microsoft—would put forth the question in the first place, implicitly suggesting that it might not. GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive has been pretty aggressive with its efforts to keep recompiled versions of GTA 6 from landing on PC, and I can't imagine it would too thrilled with Github—which, I must emphasize, is owned by Microsoft —telling the world that it might actually be okay to go ahead and vibe-code it up.

That point wasn't missed by redditors, one of whom described it as Github " openly taunting Sony and Rockstar ." Even the AnyPS5 subreddit seemed baffled: Redditor superkickstart asked, "Do they have AI running their socials? Lol"

There's also a little bit of irony in the fact that, until earlier this week, the leading effort to get GTA 6 running on PC was based on an Xbox build of the game posted by GTA 6 leaker Cyberleeks. Beyond that, there are also some very obvious questions about how Github ( owned by Microsoft ) would react to AI-powered ports of, say, other software:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/87zc6fDpWXx6MqaMX4rWjk-1920-80.png

The whole thing is weird, really, because it seems like such an obviously bad idea. The only explanation I can come up with is that a social media manager either didn't think about it, didn't understand it (which would be weird in itself for someone doing social media posts for Github), or just had a big ol' brain fart. Whatever the reason, I imagine someone got a good old-fashioned talking-to about it.
I've reached out to Github and Take-Two for comment and will update if I receive a reply.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kkNtsnEsZiTdgmuFTn4pJ6-1920-80.jpg

items.title: WoW：永远的最小最大玩家感到不安，因为它的 40 名玩家 PvP 模式现在实际上需要 PvP 才能获胜
items.summary: Blizzard's latest patch prevents Alterac Valley from being a glorified reputation farm.

content.v: Despite being set in the past, WoW: Forever is an attempt to capture the spirit of the old game by injecting it with new quirks that challenge new and returning players alike to approach it differently than any other version of the MMO. This is why familiar old dungeons can drop new loot, like an armor set that turns you into a snake .

Blizzard has said that its goal is to "unsolve" the game as best it can so players don't settle into the same routines they're used to. This is especially true for min-maxed strategies that threaten to suck the fun out of enjoying the game, or "the journey", as Blizzard likes to call it.

It's a lofty goal that can't be achieved without persistently fiddling with the knobs that encourage players to do one thing over another—which is the very thing that differentiates WoW: Forever from WoW Classic.

This week, Blizzard stepped in to fix a problem that was brewing in its 40-player MOBA-esque PvP mode Alterac Valley. Players were avoiding PvP altogether, turning it into a glorified reputation farm.

"We’ve seen that players in Alterac Valley were frequently completing the battleground without capturing the objectives, so we’ve made some adjustments to incentivize a focus on the objectives rather than rushing to kill the enemy faction’s general," community manager Kaivax wrote.

The patch basically broke a popular 'zerg' strategy where one side rushed to end the match as fast as possible by beefing up the NPC defenders that stood in their way. Blizzard shifted some of the reputation and honor you'd normally get from killing the generals to the other objectives so players are encouraged to engage with the whole mode.

But, as I've seen with changes like this in the past few weeks, many players are upset that they can't just spam it for the rewards, and that others have already reaped the benefits of the old strategy. There are people in Reddit threads doing the math to highlight how much efficiency has been lost (it doesn't seem like much) and questioning the point of doing Alterac Valley at all.

While I sympathize with not wanting to do something that feels like a chore, it's a far worse problem to have an entire part of the game flattened into an AFK farm. Alterac Valley is supposed to feel like a large-scale war where you look at a big map and choose what objectives are worth fighting over as you try to weaken the enemy forces. The loot you get from maxing out your reputation with the associated factions is meant to be a reward for putting in the effort to learn what it takes to win.

The whole pitch for WoW: Forever is that it's not going to ditch everything with a new expansion every few years. Numbers can be tweaked down the line if the reputation grind is too much of a slog, but the mode should be fun to play so it's not treated like a box to check off in your character's journey. An inert PvP mode ruins the spirit of the MMO far more than a slightly longer reputation grind does.

I think this is a good example of a healthy change that shows Blizzard is committed to protecting core parts of the experience from becoming a treadmill that nobody enjoys. WoW: Forever's strengths are the ways it encourages you to participate in systems that aren't there to fill progression bars. As Harvey said in his WoW: Forever review , "Forever is proof that old-school MMO design deserves a second chance," and that requires taking a stance on what the game is and isn't meant to be.

items.title: 露西亚女演员曼尼·L·佩雷斯发表《GTA 6》推出以来的首份声明
items.summary: Manni L. Perez, the actress who plays Lucia in GTA 6, has issued her first statement since the game came out.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/26/gtavi-38-1795726955205.jpg
Manni L. Perez, the actress who plays Lucia in GTA 6 , has issued her first statement since the game came out.

Perez’s role as Lucia Caminos was confirmed when she was nominated in the Best Performance category for this year’s The Game Awards , a day before GTA 6 launched on November 19. She’s now considered the favorite following the game’s critically acclaimed, record-breaking launch.
Now, a week later, Perez took to social media to thank fans for the reception to GTA 6.
“Life has been such a whirlwind these past couple of days and I just want to take a moment to say thank you,” an Instagram Stories post began.
“Thank you to all the new followers, to all the beautiful messages, and the positive reception the game and my character have received.
“I've dedicated almost a decade bringing Lucia to life. She's been such a significant part of mine and I am beyond grateful she now gets to be a small part of yours.”
“Happy Holiday's y'all.”

Perez is an actress with a smattering of credits to her acting resume, including TV guest roles in Jessica Jones, Chicago P.D., and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit. While she hasn't been up to much else over the past few years, it's easy to know why — GTA 6 sounds like it was a pretty involved project. Indeed, Lucia isn’t Perez's first GTA role. In GTA 5, she plays the background character of "Clubber #2," while in GTA Online she voices a blackjack dealer.
Meanwhile, Jason actor Dylan Rourke also posted a message of gratitude on Instagram Stories, saying: “Thankful for this wild ride. Gratitude won’t cut it. Make today about the ones you love.”

Manni L. Perez shouldn't be confused with Manny Perez, who plays Raul Bautista in GTA 6. This week, Manny Perez bought a PS5 just so he could play the game, saying in a video posted to social media: “Guy, I’m playing and this s**t is crazy! Look how real that looks. I’m learning, I’m loving this, it’s crazy.”

Other GTA 6 actors who've started to talk about their work on the game include Lexie Shoaibi, who recently spoke out about her "bittersweet" newfound fame after her character, Mandy, went viral online, and Cocoteo FM radio host Issa Lopez, who described the wild non-disclosure agreement she had to sign before working on the game .
Last month, the actors behind GTA 5's Franklin, Michael, and Trevor shared their advice for GTA 6's cast in a bid to ready them for the kind of fame few video game actors achieve.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

items.title: Steam isn't doing 'an official Black Friday fest,' but it does have a page with hundreds of discounts and 'Black Friday' splashed across the top so you might want to check it out anyway
items.summary: Updates to Steam's 'Discounts and Events' page are now live, and Valve wants to show them off.

content.v: Steam isn't running an official Black Friday fest—it says so right here in this update , "Steam isn't running an official Black Friday fest"—but plenty of game developers have marked their stuff down to take advantage of the big sale season, and so Valve is helping them all out a bit by "dressing up" its Discounts and Events page in the appropriate seasonal garb.
Is there a little bit of wink wink, nudge nudge to that 'not a Black Friday fest' business? Hey, maybe.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XgrthmufKHAtxiyPs3SSR3-1920-80.png

In fair play, though, Steam traditionally hasn't run Black Friday sales, because its Autumn Sale was always happening at the same time. The realignment of seasonal sales in 2025 changed that, however, leaving a hole that was filled by the first-ever Steam Black Friday Sale last year.

Valve has other priorities this year, though, which could explain the absence ( wink wink, nudge nudge ) of an official Black Friday event on Steam in 2026. In September, Valve announced changes to Steam's Discounts and Events page to make it prettier and more personalized, and it said in today's update that Black Friday is "the perfect time to share the updates we've been working on to make the Discounts & Events page a better experience altogether."

With that all cleared up, I'll say that the Black Friday non-fest page is definitely an eye-catcher, and it will be interesting to see how Valve puts this section of Steam to work in the future. If it's treated like an 'almost a Steam sale' that never really ends, I have to think that developers and gamers alike will benefit—at least until we all get used to it and Valve has to figure out some new way to tweak the formula.
For now, since we're here, let's check out some deals:

And here's one other difference between actual Steam sales and the Black Friday non-event: Valve said the Black Friday decor will come off the Discounts and Events page on November 30, but the discounts themselves all have separate end dates. The Divinity: Original Sin 2 sale, for instance, also ends on November 30, but Outer Wilds will stay marked down until December 5, and the Esoteric Ebb deal will be valid until December 7.

Update: Valve subsequently clarified that last year's Black Friday event wasn't really a Black Friday Sale either, just a dress-up of the Discounts and Events page for Black Friday, same as this year. I find it all a little confusing, but hey, deals are deals. Happy Thanksgiving!

items.title: 为避开 Silksong 而推迟了游戏一年的开发团队表示，无论 Team Cherry 明天宣布什么，他们都不会再这样做了：“这次我们将原地踏步”
items.summary: Aeternum Game Studios does have a question, though: "Is it just us, or does the universe have it in for us?"

content.v: In August 2025, Aeternum Game Studios announced that Aeterna Lucis , the sequel to the well-liked 2021 metroidvania Aeterna Noctis, would be delayed from its planned launch in September of that year to sometime in 2026, for one good reason: Silksong. Just prior to that, Team Cherry surprised everyone by announcing that the Hollow Knight: Silksong launch was imminent, and Aeternum—and a whole bunch of others —decided the smart move was to just get out of the way.

Well, here we go again. Yesterday, Team Cherry announced that " Cherry Time " is coming on November 27, with "a bunch of exciting announcements, plus an update on Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow," the Silksong expansion announced in December 2025. Some fans are hoping that means the Sea of Sorrow release date will be announced—or maybe even that it will actually be released.
Whatever's coming, Aeternum says that this time around, it's standing firm.

"Dear Team Cherry," Aeternum wrote in an Official Statement: Part 2 message, riffing on the "Official Statement" it put out in 2025. "A little over a year ago, just as we were about to launch our game, you announced Silksong. We stepped aside, pushed the whole project back a year, and, honestly, it was one of the best decisions we've ever made: The genre had an incredible year, and we got to enjoy Silksong as fans and polish Aeterna Lucis into the game we always dreamed it would be.
"Now here we are again, just days from launch. Aeterna Lucis, our new Metroidvania, comes out on December 3... and you announce Cherry Time.
"This time we're staying put. Not to go against you, but because a lot of people have been waiting for the Queen of Light for a long time, and we don't want to make them wait any longer."
Official statement, part II. Here we go again…

You might say that there's some element of opportunism at work here. Aeterna Lucis launches on December 3, one week from today, and since that's surely way too close for another delay (not to mention it was pushed back a year already), the next-best option is to leverage this new Silksong moment in whatever way possible.

Still, it's hard not to have sympathy for Aeternum. Maybe this Cherry Time announcement won't be a big deal, but then again, maybe it will be a very big deal. Aeternum is being a good sport about it, but I have to think there's some real frustration behind its message.

And with good reason. This isn't a situation like Devolver Digital launching Volvy alongside GTA 6—that is, two completely different games with virtually no meaningful audience overlap. Aeterna Lucis and Hollow Knight: Silksong are both fantasy metroidvanias, and there's a lot of potential crossover there. If Team Cherry does unload Sea of Sorrow before the end of the year, that could—almost certainly will — cut deeply into Aeterna Lucis.

"We have to ask, with all the love in the world: Is it just us, or does the universe have it in for us? Hahaha. And since you're about to wreck our lives all over again, the least we can do is make a bundle together."
Hey, you can't blame 'em for taking a shot, especially under the circumstances. "Hahaha," indeed.
Aeterna Lucis launches on Steam on December 3. Cherry Team, whatever it turns out to be, will kick off at 10 am ET/1 pm PT on November 27.

items.title: Rockstar Games 推出《侠盗猎车手 6》，但联盟投票失败
items.summary: Roughly 75% of Rockstar Games staff in the UK have voted against a formal recognition agreement with the Indep

content.v: Roughly 75% of Rockstar Games staff in the UK have voted against a formal recognition agreement with the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB). The news came in the wake of GTA 6 's record-breaking launch , and had the IWGB been recognized, Rockstar Games management would have been legally obligated to negotiate collective bargaining terms with the union on topics such as pay, hours, and conditions.

Voting took place across two weeks, and turnout was massive, with over 93% of UK staff casting their ballot (roughly 1,544 employees). The IWGB said it was undeterred by the result and would continue working to build support among Rockstar employees. "While the result means Rockstar will not be formally required to hold regular meetings with union representatives under a recognition agreement, it does not prevent workers from continuing to organize and push for workplace improvements through the IWGB, joining the union or exercising their individual trade union rights and protections," the union said in a statement.

The vote also comes hot on the heels of the IWGB taking Rockstar to an employment tribunal, alleging unlawful dismissal and union busting after it fired over 30 employees last year for gross misconduct over alleged leaks of confidential information. Closing submissions were wrapped up shortly before the vote results came out, and a ruling is still pending. While game dev unionizing has gained significant momentum over the years, a decisive loss at one of the industry's biggest studios could be a notable speed bump for union organizers.

With Rockstar also riding the wave of GTA 6's monumental success, employees may be focused on bonuses and post-launch momentum, which could make pushing through a formal union structure even harder. "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society--this isn't a sign to retreat; it's a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favor of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognize we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues,' the IWGB added.

items.title: 微软旗下的 GitHub 在现已删除的推文中庆祝 AnyPS5 Repo，震惊了追随者
items.summary: In a post that’s since been deleted, Microsoft-owned code and software collaboration site GitHub celebrated th

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/26/gtavi-21-1795712312400.jpg

In a post that’s since been deleted, Microsoft-owned code and software collaboration site GitHub celebrated the AnyPS5 repo “passing 58k stars” from users on the platform as a result of the launch of GTA 6. GitHub even told followers "Happy GTA VImas!" in a tweet that will almost certainly have infurated Rockstar Games, parent company Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox.

“GTA 6 is finally here, sparking one of the biggest weeks in gaming and open source on GitHub,” the post said, before jumping into celebrating the repo. “Does changing where games run cross a legal line?” the tweet asked.
This is insane https://t.co/mwU6VIy1nI

There was also an official video attached to the tweet, which highlighted a post from an AnyPS5 coder, via Kotaku . The post in the video said: “We have 3 days until GTA 6 everyone[…]get your agents or deevs[sic] and work.”

While the post could easily be the work of a rogue social media person, the optics aren’t good at all. GTA 6 is only officially available on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, so both Sony and Microsoft have benefited greatly from the game's record-breaking launch. To see a the Microsoft-owned GitHub post a message to its followers essentially encouraging potential piracy is remarkable.
IGN has asked for comment, but GitHub obviously realized its mistake — it deleted the tweet, after all — but how it even got approved in the first place is a mystery until the company comments.

Take-Two is currently working to take down various homebrew community efforts from GitHub, as the race to release an unofficial GTA 6 PC port heats up. This follows Cyberleek's alleged released of the executable file for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build they reportedly leaked the week prior. There’s even a website tracking the various attempts to recompile, emulate, or port the leaked Xbox Series build to PC.

The big question for Take-Two is, can it do anything meaningful to stop a working, playable build of GTA 6 on PC from getting into people's hands? GitHub takedowns can only go so far, as the homebrew scenes uses AI to speed along development. Take-Two stands to make billions of dollars more from the official PC release of GTA 6, so any unofficial version is a significant business risk. In a recent interview with IGN sister site RPS , former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij said that Rockstar Games may be keen to port GTA 6 to PC as soon as possible , due to the explosion of AI-generated clones and ports.

It's also worth noting that there is extra interest in a PC version of GTA 6 because the console versions target 30fps. The PC version, resumably, will run at 60fps or whatever frame rate your rig is capable of .

Earlier this month, Strauss Zelnick, the boss of Take-Two, responded to the threat of AI-assisted reverse-engineering and decompilation of games in an interview with IGN. He said he was taking the issue seriously, and insisted that fans will prefer to play GTA 6 officially, with all its bells and whistles as Rockstar intended, over an unofficial PC version.
Here’s the exchange:

IGN: We've seen hackers using AI to clone games much faster than ever before, even try to jailbreak consoles. And there is some concern about this leading to potentially GTA 6 being made available on PC unofficially or places that you aren't releasing it. I was just wondering how much of a threat this is to your business? And, is there anything meaningful you can do about it?

Strauss Zelnick: I don't think it’s a financial matter, in terms of a threat to our business. I do think it’s a creative matter. It's important to everyone, our developers and our consumers alike, to deliver the experience Rockstar envisions. And at the same time, of course, we protect our intellectual property vigilantly. So we are focused on these concerns. We're not in the least cavalier about them. Technology is advancing quickly. And at the same time, I do think that pretty much everyone wants the Rockstar experience as Rockstar intended.

IGN: Related, last week Anthropic confirmed they took steps to block Claude from reverse engineering video games. I would assume you would welcome that. And would you like to see other AI companies like OpenAI do the same thing to prevent people from using these powerful AI models to clone your games?

Strauss Zelnick: I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's. And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected.

During an investor-focused Q&A following the release of Take-Two’s latest financial report, attended by IGN, Zelnick was asked multiple times about the AI reverse-engineering problem. He, again, had strong words in response, suggesting Take-Two was ready to lawyer up.

“This business has been largely immune to piracy concerns forever because of file sizes, complexity of piracy, being connected to servers and the like,” he began. “And undoubtedly, it would be very difficult to replicate the experience of consuming our game as intended because of technical limitations.

“That said, it's going to become more of a challenge, as you said, and we're aware of that. So we are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defenses and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. And at the same time, without in any way being cavalier, every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy. So this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it.”

Zelnick’s talk about legal activities sparks an obvious question: what can game companies do about AI-assisted reverse engineering? It's a question IGN recently asked when people started to work on a PC port of Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake .

items.title: GTA 6 的某些方面受到了 Red Dead Redemption 2 荣誉系统的启发，因为其玩家代理机构“是很难忽视和放弃的”
items.summary: "As the resolution goes up, you want the sophistication of the experience to go up."

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't just mark a huge, and at times unbelievable, step forward for graphics; it's also at the forefront of what an open world game can be, just look at the existential crisis it's given Cyberpunk 2's creative director . With thousands of enterable buildings , unpredictable and slightly scary NPCs , and systems that help you determine what kind of criminal you want to be. It all really does feel like a milestone for what videogames can do.

"As the resolution goes up, you want the sophistication of the experience to go up, and obviously the sophistication of the mechanics," Rob Nelson, Rockstar's head of development, says in an interview with Eurogamer. "So it just naturally flowed that we give players choices to interact with the world beyond just violence, beyond just 'down the barrel of a gun', because it's fun."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7YrZz3pEuAAU8AtDMkeDJY-1920-80.png

The sophisticated mechanics that Nelson is talking about here pertains to GTA 6's Criminal Profile , a system that evaluates your escapades across Leonida and gives you a rating. There's Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable. The more stealthy and non-lethal you are, the higher your profile will be. It's similar to Red Dead Redemption 2's Honor System .

"There was maybe more emotional resonance in the story of RDR2 than we had, certainly in a GTA before," Nelson says. "So we liked that idea. We didn't necessarily come to GTA 6 going: 'We must have emotional resonance,' but all of those things combine. It's more that those systems and that element of player choice and agency, and the way that affected the narrative, was a hard thing to ignore and walk away from."

Nelson explains that most of the groundwork started as "simple things" in principle, "but they create a lot more work in terms of development of the sophistication of the systems." It's all about choice in GTA 6. You choose whether you want to be a criminal with a conscience or a loose cannon.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/56BRYZarF8fzYxibbaoZbe-1920-80.jpg

"It's still a world of violence, but you could threaten somebody by aiming a gun at them and just robbing them, and they have a chance to comply. So you don't have to beat them to death to get their money."

The part that sticks out the most is that you "don't have to" approach crimes in a certain way, there's still the option to go into every encounter guns blazing because redemption only works from a storytelling perspective when it's the player's choice, and not as Nelson puts it, something that is "foisted upon you".

"You can still go on those rampages and basically smash your Criminal Profile until it breaks," Nelson adds. "And then you enter this irredeemable state, which basically says, 'I reject your criminal profile system! I don't want it.'"

Am I brave enough to reject the criminal profile system entirely? Hell no. I replay sections of dialogue if I accidentally upset someone, and cannot do an "evil run" of a game without giving myself stomach ulcers because of the guilt — but I appreciate having the option.

items.title: 哪里可以找到 GTA 6 的 UFO 和外星人
items.summary: Get down with the extraterrestrial.

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 might feel more grounded compared to its predecessors, but that doesn't mean Leonida isn't full of weird and supernatural ongoings. One such paranormal activity is GTA 6's aliens—if you know where to look, you'll be able to find a UFO which'll eventually lead you down a strange road of cows, radiation, and the aliens themselves.
And if you don't know where to look, here's where I can help you. If you want to find GTA 6's UFO and a weird little alien guy, here's exactly where you need to go and what you need to do.
How to find GTA 6's alien
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9bhgQwktPLV95VZz3j3h3W-1920-80.png

The alien abduction is actually a three-parter mission, and to get started you'll first need to locate the abandoned car. You'll need to look for it at nighttime, and it can spawn in a number of locations. For me, it was a little ways east of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County. For our own Chris Livingston, he discovered the car somewhere north of Capri, also in Kelly County. You know it's the one if the car is pointed toward a forest and the doors are open.

Once you've found it, you'll need to follow the path it's parked along. You'll know you're going the right way by the clothes strewn along the path. If it's a bit too dark or you're stuck, you can press L3 + R3 to activate your focus and see the clothes more easily or equip your flashlight. Eventually you'll see the lights of the UFO and a very naked lady amongst it all. Head over until a cutscene plays out.

Once that's over, you'll get into a light scuffle with the woman before she instructs you to go get her car. Head back to where you first found the vehicle, where one more cutscene will play out and you'll be done… for now.
Alien abduction: part two
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eePh6ji7cz25WAFALuj53W-1920-80.png

You'll need to wait for some time to pass. Make sure you're heading home and going to sleep each night, preferably as whichever character you discovered the UFO on. Eventually, you'll trigger a cutscene that'll bring you to a white room.

Find the dark oval which signals the way to a corridor and run through it. You'll be met with a terrifying maze of eggs. Get close to them and they'll start glowing blue. Get too close and they'll turn yellow, eventually cracking and causing your character to be yoinked back to the start by tentacles.

Carefully make your way through the eggs, finding large gaps where you won't cause them to break. Once you've made it to the other side, you'll be met with another room containing the solar system. Take a look at earth—this is actually showing you where you'll need to head for part three of this mission—and continue onwards until you reach a code.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nrx6hx7dDRSpnjnRZToEhU-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tKKwiRDaSbzKegTZUGzs4W-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MbsiMDomfmXu8NrHyaCS5W-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KySR77a5nw8VurELy75c3W-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XRCuTnioBBRW9GQmkDbP4W-1920-80.png
To decipher the code, simply look at how many lines are in each of the four symbols above the keypad. For me, the code was 3124. Punch in the code, and head to the next room.

Here, you'll need to push the button on the control panel and light it up. The aim is to have four green lights, so keep pushing until all four are the same colour and then pull the lever to the left.

Once that's done, you'll be met with three metal doors. The middle one'll do some nasty damage if you step into the room and hang around too long, so avoid it. Instead, head to the room on the left—yes, the one with the cows—and run in to grab the bottle of milk on the table.

Run back out and head for the door on the right. Walk to the end until you see a contraption where you're able to insert your milk bottle. Shortly after, you'll wake up back in your bed and ready to tackle the final part of this mission chain.
Alien abduction: part three
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uWAwGSaANyCzUYbrreW74W-1920-80.png
You'll want to head over to the location shown to you in the globe. More specifically, you'll want to head south of Hamlet, at this abandoned building just west of the river.

There'll be a gap in the fence you can hop over, or you can shoot the padlock, or alternatively ram into the gate with your car. From here, you can either climb on top of the roof and drop down or find the double doors and kick them down, or use the snap gun. Either way, you'll want to make sure the door is unlocked for later in this mission.
Turn around and head down the stairs, towards the keypad at the end of the corridor. The code here is the same as the one you used earlier, so punch it in again and head into the elevator.

Walk through the tunnel and you'll once again be met with a control panel and three doors, plus a little audiotape with some fun exposition about alien experimentation. You'll be doing the exact same thing here as you did earlier—get every light to green, push the lever, and head into the left room to retrieve a bottle of milk. The middle room once again doles out gnarly damage, so don't hang too long or avoid it all together.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RnSXyKVbH5fBX6crQF8g4j-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7Xu74rKwYt3wJaNokAUv7W-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4r7TNLXemUzT3rDjtfbnBW-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FDWu7oACrejjbKjX2VcT5W-1920-80.png

Head over to the door on the right, down the corridor and into the room. Insert the milk bottle into the contraption and after a few seconds, out will pop a little alien guy! It's unconscious, though, so you'll need to pick it up.

As soon as you've picked up the alien, the bunker will begin to fill with toxic gas and you'll need to head out ASAP. Go back the way you came—through the tunnel and into the elevator, and then through those double doors you snap gunned/kicked down earlier to get outside.

Sadly, your time with this alien fella is brief, as it'll quickly get beamed up into the sky by a UFO. It also doesn't take long for special forces to show up, but don't worry. The UFO will return to laser them all down, allowing you to get out without any further issues.
For your troubles, the aliens will give you a permanent buff to your health, stamina, and focus, so helping out these extraterrestrials is more than worth the effort. And, y'know, the trauma.

items.title: Rockstar 工人以压倒性多数投票反对承认工会
items.summary: The IWGB says efforts will continue, but with only 25% of Rockstar workers voting in favor, there's a long way

content.v: After two weeks of voting that bracketed the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, Rockstar Games employees have voted overwhelmingly against a recognition agreement with the IWGB Game Workers Union.
25% of Rockstar employees voted in favor of the recognition agreement, the union said, while 75% voted against it. 1,544 employees took part in the vote, representing a turnout of just over 93%.

Rockstar workers actually founded a union earlier this year—the Rockstar Game Workers Union, a subsidiary of the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain—and it will continue to operate as it has. The IWGB said the outcome will not prevent Rockstar workers from organizing or exercising union rights, but the company will not be required to regularly meet with union representatives for collective bargaining or other relevant matters.
Despite the vote, the union said it will continue with organizing efforts at Rockstar.

"For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society—this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognize we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues," the IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union said. "We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen.

"Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us."
The power to shape our working lives has always been, and always will be, in our hands
In a separate statement, Rockstar head of publishing Jennfer Kolbe said the studio is "extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6."

"This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong," Kolbe said. "As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together."

Rockstar, which said it worked with the IWGB to ensure employees were able to make an informed decision in a fair and transparent vote, came under fire in October 2025 for firing more than 30 employees, all of whom were members of a private trade union Discord channel. The IWGB called it " the most ruthless act of union busting in the history of the UK games industry ," while Rockstar says they were fired for leaking information about "upcoming and unannounced games." That matter is now before an employment tribunal ; closing submissions were made last week.

items.title: Rockstar 解释为什么缺少一些额外的暴力武器，即使对于 GTA 6 来说，电锯也“太多了”
items.summary: Rockstar has explained why some extra violent weapons like chainsaws and katanas are missing from GTA 6.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/26/gtavi-15-1795709349508.jpg

You can commit an extreme amount of violence in GTA 6 , with a wide variety of weaponry. Guns, baseball bats, even tanks can be your chosen tool of destruction. But that hasn’t stopped some from wondering where some series favourites have disappeared to.

Among those are the likes of katanas and chainsaws, which were staples during Grand Theft Auto’s “3D universe” games, including Vice City and San Andreas. The chainsaw, in particular, holds a special connection to Vice City given its clear Scarface inspirations, and memorable scene involving the power tool from the 1983 movie.

But despite some being spotted around the latest version of Leonida in GTA 6, neither Jason nor Lucia can wield them as weapons. Why? Well, Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson explained the decision in an interview with VGC .

“As far as the chainsaw — I think it would have been too much for this game at this resolution and these characters,” Nelson says. "It’s not a resource thing. Even at the most psycho, did Jason and Lucia really need that — what’s that going to look like?”

When asked specifically about why chainsaws are lying about the world, but can’t be picked up, Nelson explained that, “you’re always trying to find what is the right sort of line and the right balance; it really just depends — you want to feel like you can interact with as much of the world as possible.”

I have to somewhat agree that it just wouldn’t feel like it fit either Jason or Lucia’s characters to be roaming around looking for limbs to chop off with a mechanised serrated blade. Ultimately, their story is one about committing crime to escape to a better, more “normal” life, not one about two psychopaths with a lust for blood going on a rampage.

That being said, when whatever the online component of GTA 6 launches, I could see objects like this becoming weapons, allowing for people to roleplay as whatever brand of criminal, psychopath, or tree sculptor they wish. There’s a world of possibilities out there.

items.title: 如何在 GTA 6 中窃取 Bravado Banshee
items.summary: Grab this striped sports car for Randy.

content.v: The Bravado Banshee is another one of the cars you'll need to track down for Randy in GTA 6 , but unlike the Pegassi Infernus , this one doesn't involve anything as dodgy as robbing a police lockup.

You can find this car inside the Sunrise Premium Autos showroom at the north tip of Southside, southwest of Pay 'N' Spray - Salton or east across the road from Ron Gas - Southside. This region is to the northeast of Hamlet.

There are two showrooms here, so make sure you have the right one, though the other does contain Pfister Growlers, in case you haven't gotten that car for Randy yet, either. Head inside to find the car—if you've played previous GTAs, you'll recognise it as a convertible with a white stripe down the middle. Hop inside, use the key cloner, and drive it through the glass.

This might damage it a bit, but you can always repair it at Ron Gas nearby, or at the gas station near Randy's shop. Just remember to drive fast, and if the tracker starts to beep, speed up to stop it pinging your location to the cops. Delivering this one gets you 6,500k and a 5k condition bonus as usual if it's in good nick.

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/1c384d6021ece3c4ddb00de035b2b9d3.jpg_mw680water
即将于12月3日发售的《雷曼：传奇再叙》，是育碧于2013年推出的横版平台跳跃游戏《雷曼：传奇》的重制版。
除了画面革新，这次《再叙》最大的变化，在于加入了一条贯穿冒险的主线剧情，以及全配音的过场动画。
游戏也在今天凌晨发布了一支全新的剧情宣传预告，包含了中文配音的版本。
来自育碧米兰工作室、担任该作叙事演出总监（Realization Director）的Marco Renso，在采访中向我们解释了这样做的动机：
“我们想加强雷曼世界中各个地方、生物与角色之间的联系，为这个世界观打下扎实的基础。讲故事也让我们有机会探索更多情绪：从幽默、欢乐，到紧张、惊奇，以及一些让人静下来思考的时刻，同时保留雷曼原有的精神。”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/8847fa932a3e986adf7302a055e2bfb6.jpg_mw680water
Marco Renso
这当然不是一件容易的事。
原版《雷曼：传奇》虽然是个横版过关游戏，但关卡结构相当开放——玩家可以自由往返于不同国度、决定通关顺序，也可以自由选择操控的角色。怎样把这些原本相对独立的关卡串成一个故事，又不影响玩家选择路线的自由，是团队需要解决的难题。
Marco他们想到了一些办法。除了过场动画，他们也把叙事放进了场景之中。比如在新增的飞龙关里，玩家在体验紧张刺激的飞行射击的同时，也能纵览整个国度的鲜活生态，对其有一个更生动的印象。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/2412361b7b7577cc65f53286d9c2b645.jpg_mw680water
新增的飞龙骑乘关卡，让玩家从空中穿行游戏世界
更大的变化，是《再叙》完全重构了各个国度的关卡大厅。
原版里，大厅只是挂着画的房间，玩家跳进画里就进入对应关卡；如今，它们成了各自国度的一部分，有角色生活其中，也有环境细节和隐藏内容可供探索。
新增国度“青灰死地”里的贝蒂拉仙女很直观地体现了这一点。
她在系列作品中的重要角色，她的形象和性格有过多次变化。《再叙》中，她第一次显现了巨大化的身形，连性格和说话语气都随之变得沉稳，有了一种更接近于神明的感觉。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/ba34fd6b9adedce29170a4a64c04cd57.jpg_mw680water
贝蒂拉仙女
在青灰死地的关卡大厅里，她会矗立在背景中，眼神却始终温柔地跟随着玩家移动。Marco说，他们希望玩家感觉到她一直存在于这个世界中，而不是只有剧情需要时才出现。游戏里的其他角色，大多也伴随着叙事内容的增加，以及得益于完整的配音，像这样获得了更立体的塑造。
要像这样在游戏中加入完整的影视级叙事，通常会面对两个问题。
首先当然是成本。
如今，非大型3D动作游戏通常很难卖到60美元，自然也得控制各方面的制作成本。与核心玩法关联不那么紧密的过场动画，往往是最先被砍预算的部分。
直到《双人成行》的成功，让大家看到即便是以平台跳跃为核心玩法、不卖3A定价的游戏，也值得精心制作的叙事演出。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/c21576e164581f00ffde97f6f28c759f.png_mw680water
此次《雷曼：传奇再叙》Steam国区售价168元，包含预购奖励
当然，这也是因为制作人Josef Fares本就有电影导演的背景，自带探索叙事与玩法结合的动机和经验。一般团队即便有这样的想法，除了肯花钱，还得有一些开发技术支撑，才可能避免只是把玩法内容和叙事播片生硬地拼接在一起。
技术和开发工具的积累，则恰好是育碧的强项。
Marco介绍，《再叙》同时使用了育碧自研的雪花莲（Snowdrop）引擎，以及原作采用的UbiArt Framework：后者继续负责横版关卡及其玩法逻辑，前者则负责现代光照等视觉表现，搭建新的3D世界。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/ab3aa14ce1fc250bcc570383c9992cfc.jpg_mw680water
重制后的战斗场景，在横版关卡中加入立体的环境与光照
Marco说，他们的目标是找到一种适合雷曼的基调，而不是对现有某种风格的模仿——对于一个正作停摆了13年的系列来说，能在回归时获得这样的投入，以及做一些大胆新尝试的勇气，还是挺让人高兴的。
也愿该作能达成众多粉丝们盼望依旧的期待，成为雷曼系列的一个新起点。
以下是此次采访的完整内容：
Q：首先能否大致介绍一下，《雷曼：传奇再叙》增加了多少新的故事内容？
Marco： 很难用一个数字来衡量，因为故事并不是在原作之上单独加上去的一块内容。它为这场冒险带来了一条新的线索，把不同国度和角色联系起来。
游戏加入了新的反派、第六个国度和全配音的过场动画，也把一些新的叙事片段融入了游戏世界。我们的目标是让整段旅程更加连贯，同时让平台跳跃始终处于核心位置。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/5d3fc9e2aca51a11de8a12e9db69bf7c.jpg_mw680water
幽暗场景中的战斗与探索，呈现雷曼世界的另一种气氛
Q：为什么想在这次重制中，进一步充实故事？
Marco： 雷曼系列一直拥有一个非常丰富的世界，有各种不同的地方、生物和角色。我们想加强它们之间的联系，为这个世界观打下扎实的基础。
故事也让我们有机会探索更多情绪：从幽默、欢乐，到紧张、惊奇，以及一些让人静下来思考的时刻，同时保留雷曼原有的精神。
Q：《双人成行》这类拥有完整故事的合作游戏取得成功，是否影响了你们的决定？
Marco： 我不会把某一款游戏当作我们作出这个决定的原因。我们着眼于雷曼自己的世界，思考怎样让这场冒险更连贯，也让角色有更多表达自己的空间。
当然，把故事与玩法结合起来的游戏能够带来启发，但我们最终选择这个方向，是因为它适合雷曼。
Q：原作已经有很多关卡了。要用一个新故事来串联这些原本分散的关卡，最困难的地方是什么？
Marco： 挑战在于，让故事感觉本来就属于这个世界，而不是覆盖在关卡之上的一层东西。
《雷曼：传奇》原本就有丰富的变化和鲜明的个性。我们希望新的叙事能让冒险更加连贯，同时保留玩家喜爱的场景与玩法。
我们也想保留原作的结构，让玩家能够以非线性的方式往返于不同国度。这增加了组织故事的难度，但保留这种自由对我们很重要。玩家应该能够选择自己的冒险路线。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14681/6508805a2aa4387fde2660c8a3def04a.jpg_mw680water
色彩明快的摔跤手追逐关卡，延续系列夸张热闹的风格
Q：有因为新故事而回头去调整原有的关卡内容吗？
Marco： 变化最大的是关卡大厅。在原作中，它们只是一些挂着画的简单房间，玩家跳进画里，就能进入相应关卡。
在《再叙》中，我们希望它们更像可以探索的地方，因此彻底重做了这些区域。现在，每个大厅都是其对应国度的一部分，里面有角色和环境细节，帮助玩家融入这个世界。对于喜欢探索的玩家，每个大厅里也都藏着一些可以发现的东西……
Q：我注意到，新的飞龙关里也有一些叙事细节。例如，有一关飞过去时，能看到那个巨大的摔跤手正在做饭。你们怎样决定哪些内容让玩家在游玩过程中看到，哪些通过过场动画讲述？
Marco： 我们希望故事存在于游戏世界里，而不只是出现在过场动画中。
过场动画可以推动情节，帮助玩家与角色建立联系；而游玩时发生在背景里的事情，则能让世界显得鲜活，也给那些留心观察的玩家一些回报。
飞龙关很适合做这样的事情：它们连接着冒险中的不同部分，玩家在穿行世界时，可以观察周围的角色和细节。
Q：《再叙》中的贝蒂拉，无论外观还是给人的感觉，都有很大变化。你们是怎样形成这个新形象的？之前试玩时，我对她在“青灰死地”的背景中注视着我的景象印象深刻。这个设计是怎么来的？
Marco： 很高兴那一幕给你留下了印象！在我们的设想中，贝蒂拉既是仙女，也是自然之灵，可以呈现不同的形态，其中就包括一个极具威严的人形。

items.title: 别带着“肌肉记忆”玩《蓝色星原：旅谣》

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/39b8fec73702e505379a5132cdf467cf.jpg_mw680water
对二游内容形态的一系列新探索。
“你说的对，但玉枝倚宝扇，花间千丝系尘缘，因果已结！”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/0e22ecc3a96f59b06505bc1cf551060c.png_mw680water
就在今天，《蓝色星原：旅谣》（以下简称《蓝色星原》）终于迎来了正式公测。
作为游戏首个限定卡池UP角色，涂山小玉迅速成为了玩家社区中的热门话题。我在不少玩家群和社交平台，都看到了以小玉台词为模板进行整活的定型文，以及，各种各样的表情包。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/44f914ec3fec3c8154e262f36dd0c605.gif_mw680
此前，我们也曾多次报道过这款产品。作为蛮啾历时五年打磨的新作，《蓝色星原》从首曝起就攒足了关注度，公测前预约量也突破了3000万。
而在过去几轮测试中，从大世界探索、奇波捕捉养成到家园经营，游戏本身也在不断调整和迭代。随着公测正式开启，这款被讨论了许久的新作，终于完整地摆到了所有玩家面前。
而真正上手体验一圈后，不少玩家才发现，蛮啾在公测版本里其实藏了不少超出预期的改动。
事实上，早在几天前《蓝色星原》的诸多玩法就已经成为了玩家社区讨论的话题。
但由于《蓝色星原》涉及的玩法系统相当丰富，有限的直播时间很难将每个板块都充分展开。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/3991fefd04fc713585b909ec724965c3.jpg_mw680water
谁不喜欢打牌呢
但此前只能通过前瞻直播了解的内容，如今正式摆在了玩家面前。实际体验过后就会发现前期测试中存在的一些问题已经得到了很多针对性优化。
比如，玩家社区讨论最多的抽卡问题。此前测试中，《蓝色星原》的限定卡池已经采用了90抽保底、必定不歪的机制，
而在公测版本中，蛮啾进一步调整了概率机制： 90抽不歪池不变，但从第70抽以后，每抽的出货概率提升2%，到了第80抽后，提升幅度更是达到每抽8%；
如果当前卡池没有抽出限定角色，无论是已经积累的抽取次数，还是后半段的概率提升幅度， 都可以继承至下个版本。但即使如此，还是有玩家无法忘记歪卡的“肌肉记忆”带来的痛苦体验，于是就诞生了以下名场面：
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/f9a5880d98ca03809a0299f31513185a.png_mw680water
设想一下，当你看中一个限定角色时，即便手头的抽卡资源不足以支撑一次保底，也不妨随手抽上几发。能够抽到自然是件好事而且也不用担心接近保底的时候一发一发抽，即使这次十连提前抽中，剩下积累的抽数也不会浪费，这个规则注定了不需要为了抽卡绞尽脑汁，在下个版本新卡池开启，便能直接享受此前积累的高概率。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/9e58300f9a862e31a75caaa82c83f883.png_mw680water
黄鸡：“老实抽卡，很枯燥吧。”
这种「抽了也不亏」的底气，正是不歪池带给我的最直观的感受。相比于攒够保底才敢下池，玩家可以更加自由地按照自己的喜好来安排抽卡，而不必在每个版本都精打细算。就在今天，我已经看到不少玩家顺利抽到了涂山小玉，并纷纷在社交平台晒出了自己的出货截图。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/b0f2ad20a3a57f97de387d99bb77e067.jpg_mw680water
玩家社区的风向也逐渐开始真正讨论起了游戏内容。随着大家真正进入游戏，才发现原来黄鸡闷头不吭声，但活倒是一点没少干。从商业化体系、奇波养成到大世界探索，游戏所呈现出的变化，远比此前大家猜测的更加充分。
而真正的玩家也只能带着几分“恨铁不成钢”的意味感叹“老实黄鸡”“不会画饼”：
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/c3873fee1c74f37075d55933740c1e2b.png_mw680water
当然，商业化和大量减负，也只是《蓝色星原》这次公测调整的一部分。除了回应玩家在第三次测试中提出的问题外，蛮啾也进一步迭代了游戏中的各项玩法。
而这些变化，或许更能体现《蓝色星原》在公测版本中的进步。
首先是奇波系统。
作为一款以捉宠为核心玩法的游戏，捕捉奇波自然是《蓝色星原》最重要的体验之一。我自己参与了此前的每一轮测试，也能明显感受到，奇波系统一直在随着测试反馈不断调整。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/3648ad0f920ab6f475b586567ea1b86e.png_mw680water
到了公测版本，这套系统又迎来了一轮优化。
比如，Boss的捕捉难度进一步降低，游戏还对最佳捕捉时机进行了更加直观的可视化提示。玩家将Boss的血量削减至星结卡（即捕捉道具）标记的范围时，就能开始对Boss尝试进行星结，不必再反复试探。
除此之外，投掷卡片还新增了追踪效果，且骑乘状态下也可以直接投掷。
此前，游戏曾在三测中取消投掷卡片时的慢镜头表现，让部分玩家捉宠更为顺畅。这次又新增追踪机制，能让投出的卡片自动追随目标，便不再需要慢镜头辅助瞄准。这样既保证了玩家的正常游玩流程不会被慢镜头频繁打断，又保证了捕捉操作的准确性。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/e1a1f8b8524c7bd652be19b054c0fcca.jpg_mw680water
这是一个很有意思的调整，相比于简单恢复某个玩家依赖的功能，在新旧机制之间进行切换，蛮啾显然也在思考，究竟应该怎样解决玩家在实际操作中遇到的问题，寻找更适合的方案。
而这种调整并不只是发生在奇波系统上。从战斗体验到大世界探索，《蓝色星原》公测版本都进行了不少细节上的优化。比如，在大世界探索方面，游戏进一步丰富了植被和场景建模的细节，并优化了整体光影表现，让不同区域呈现出更加丰富的视觉层次；
而在战斗方面，此前让不少玩家感到压力的Boss狂暴机制也被彻底取消，玩家不必再因为输出压力而过分紧张。
至于家园经营，公测版本也进一步提高了各类建筑的建造上限，增加了农田和牧场的数量，并扩大了食物储存上限，让玩家能够更加自由地规划家园布局和生产安排。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/700887ae74e35c423d81dec04d41dc16.png_mw680water
这些调整无疑让玩家在公测版本中获得了更加舒适的游戏体验。但在此之上，比这些改动本身更值得关注的是，其中不少设计都经历了类似奇波捕捉系统那样的螺旋式上升，才逐渐变成如今的样子。
而这种螺旋式上升，其实也是游戏研发中很重要的一部分。尤其对于第一次尝试大世界捉宠游戏的蛮啾来说，很多东西本就没有现成的答案，只能在一次次测试中发现问题、吸收反馈，尝试寻找更好的解决方案。
我觉得这也是蛮啾在《蓝色星原》的研发过程中展现出的难得之处：始终保持着学习和进步的意愿，愿意不断审视和修正自己此前的设计。对于一款需要长期运营的游戏来说，这种持续发现问题、解决问题的能力，或许比某个阶段的产品表现更为重要。
而事实上，如果暂时抛开蛮啾通过一系列调整回应玩家、兢兢业业做好一款游戏的叙事，《蓝色星原》公测版本本身，其实仍有不少值得展开的内容。
比如，作为首位UP池限定角色，《蓝色星原》专门为涂山小玉准备了一套名为“花会缘结之约”的养成玩法。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14680/9ca967d788799c903459c8adf6802e75.png_mw680water
这并非二游中常见的角色剧情或小游戏，甚至可以说是一款独立而完整的内置CRPG，单次完整体验需要花费一个小时以上。
在游戏中，玩家需要亲自为小玉规划修行日程，在法力、勇气、结缘、洞察四项属性之间进行取舍，安排出行、处理随机奇遇，与其他角色建立羁绊，最终陪伴她通过狐仙考核。
也与前几天发布的涂山小玉角色PV中的“修行”主题相互呼应
并且，游戏为这套玩法准备了相当丰富的演出。从不同修行状态到随机事件，几乎每个重要环节都有对应动画。推进至关键节点和结局，游戏还会提供一整段高质量剧情演出。同时，整个游戏设计了五种不同结局，让玩家可以通过不同的培养路线反复游玩。
整套内容下来，能够看出蛮啾为此投入了相当可观的美术资源，完全超出了既往二游角色专属内容的规格。
但有意思的是，“花会缘结之约”并没有强迫所有玩家都投入大量时间。对于只想领取奖励的玩家来说，可以选择快速通关，完成必要目标后领取奖励；而对于真正喜欢这套玩法，或是希望借此进一步了解小玉、与她有更多相处时间的玩家来说，它又有着足够丰富的内容。
其设计思路不是用数值或资源来绑架玩家的精力与时间，而是提供更多“陪伴”。
熟悉蛮啾玩家大概会发现，“陪伴感”其实也是蛮啾一直以来所重视的游戏体验：让玩家不止感到游戏中的角色陪伴了自己，也会在陪伴角色经历各种事件的过程中，感受到自己的付出，形成一种双向的情感交流。
而到了《蓝色星原》，更细致的互动和更加广阔的3D世界，也为这一思路提供了新的发挥空间。而这显然只是一个新的开始，眼下呈现的内容远远不是终点，这也让我期待蛮啾未来能够在这个方向上继续探索，带来更多不同的尝试和惊喜。

items.title: 搞这么蘑幻现实主义，这里还是终末地吗？
items.summary: 前有饼，竟然是菇。 在二游社群里，“发饼”算是游戏玩家对官方内容预告的一种戏称。而对于《明日方舟》的玩家来说，这个词不仅发展成了一套饼学文化，饼和蘑菇这两种看似八竿子打不着的东西，也非常神秘地发生了关联。 这一切都要从《

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/d7c16306c876a689c7877d6526eac59c.png_mw680water
前有饼，竟然是菇。
在二游社群里，“发饼”算是游戏玩家对官方内容预告的一种戏称。而对于《明日方舟》的玩家来说，这个词不仅发展成了一套饼学文化，饼和蘑菇这两种看似八竿子打不着的东西，也非常神秘地发生了关联。
这一切都要从《明日方舟》中的干员刻俄柏说起。
甫一登场，刻俄柏的人设就给玩家留下了鲜明的印象：一只呆萌且“很饿的狗”，愿意用任何东西交换最爱吃的蜜饼。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/2eac7e8f89f244a0f67297ba0f8999b4.jpg_mw680water
剧情中，罗德岛的食堂后厨甚至悬挂着“小刻禁止入内”的标识
而在后来的初代肉鸽「刻俄柏的灰蕈迷境」里，刻俄柏因为贪吃而误食了毒蘑菇，由此进入幻觉中的蜜饼城堡，带来了一场期间限定的迷幻冒险。特别结局里，刻俄柏从幻觉中醒来，手中凭空出现了一袋最爱的蜜饼，可以说是显化大成功。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/cb93bef27f9126675ce9996bd7820ee4.png_mw680water
刻俄柏相关的剧情中，确实可以考据出不少文化上的渊源：什么地狱三头犬、什么希腊葬礼习俗啦……但是对大部分玩家来说，看到“饼”字，就宛如被小刻夺舍一般，自动联想到“鹰角发饼”。
此后，每当蹲新活动蹲到心急难耐时，玩家们便会聚集在官博下齐呼：饼饼，饿饿。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/d495ac95fbdf0e3b3e0c71e2ad6d08e5.png_mw680water
激情显化中
而那些热衷于研究官方发饼节奏的玩家，就此衍生出了一门名为“饼学”的民间学科，开始按秒推理鹰角什么时候发新活动PV。
随着鹰角的发饼节奏越来越“自由”，饼学大厦塌了又塌。但是，饼、菇和小刻的相关性，已经随着这一系列梗牢牢铭刻在了玩家心里，无需论证。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/825fc59b845d87a9cc3d12552612f3c9.png_mw680water
尽管如今的饼学大厦乌云笼罩，但攻略区仍有“小刻也能看懂”的传说
或许这也是为什么，在《明日方舟：终末地》新版本「穿越甚大蘑境与你相逢」（以下简称“甚大蘑境”）中，再旅者小刻来到了塔卫二，蜜饼和蘑菇也跟着一块“再旅”了过来。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/01a8c2394e1dd2036f468167129a0a46.gif_mw680
硬要说的话，终末地和菇其实也存在一些渊源。还记得刚开服的时候，不少玩家热衷于在某些神秘位置留下一块神秘的留言板。
词条组合本来就已经带着点莫名的幽默，其中还掺杂着蔫坏的整活。这让不少玩家联想起了《艾尔登法环》中的经典体验：费劲浑身力气抵达留言处，点开一看就一句“前有菇”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/8cad56fd8a71d578f14d68bd1c884fa5.jpg_mw680water
等到现在的“甚大蘑境”，“蘑菇人”小怪堂堂登场，类魂梗也是如约而至。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/65edd2e693a6987a8acf6e16bba6b275.jpg_mw680water
看过PV后，我对这个故事的大致预想是，“一段跳脱的旅途插曲”，似乎跟武陵的现实主义主基调有些不符？
毕竟，武陵这个地方太有说法，之前的剧情中就有不少大学生和社畜都能共情的细节，在科幻世界观下也显得非常现实主义外溢。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/51cc82895c92ada562cd1a4a116e5592.gif_mw680
但考虑到菌子密度如此之高，超现实也算是情有可原——更何况，谁不喜欢可爱小狗呢？
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/adf93a6959df650454c5cc231361a6d5.gif_mw680
很萌的小狗，宠溺是人之常情
然而实际体验下来，我发现自己最初的预期大错特错。
当饼、菇和小刻在武陵一同登场，你开始可能以为只有“魔幻”的部分，但终末地最终带来的，是一场彻头彻尾的“蘑幻现实主义”旅程。
刚进入新区域，你大概会以为要经历一场“爱丽丝梦游仙境”般的童话冒险。
阳光下，巨大的蘑菇在岩石和建筑间肆意生长，茂密的热带植被间也散落着小小的菌子。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/6721c03056d489e39e5983b67006bc0a.jpg_mw680water
除了经典的红伞伞白杆杆，这里的蘑菇还有很多难以名状的形态。一眼看上去，感觉空气都变得潮湿了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14677/c67179fc5d941b95a2d159393ce67b42.gif_mw680
预感会变成拍照热门取景地
穿行其中，路边的小蘑菇还有着不少可爱的交互动画，有的会在你踩过时发光，有的会Q弹地爆出一小团孢子。
踩蘑菇的小姑娘.gif
但从管理员被一群扭动的“神秘气球人”包围开始，一切都开始变得不对劲了。
当什么离谱的画面都可以用“蘑菇致幻”解释，终末地这次是彻底放飞了。
跳进水管可以被传送，疑似致敬意大利传奇水管工
在“甚大蘑境”，你不仅能欣赏蘑菇站在蘑菇上跳舞、听到蘑菇在悲鸣，还会被蘑菇揍。
被蘑菇打了，这找谁说理去
蘑菇都会说话了，饼当然也能说话。并且，你还将看到一块饼掏出了堆成了两罗丹高的饼山，企图借此策反我方小刻。
传下去，蜜饼偷狗
以上这些场景全部出现在幻觉中，这菇且还说得过去。但回归到终末地的现实，一些场景仍然离奇到让我一度觉得，“虚拟致幻孢子会通过网络传播”。
比如，这个地图里，玩家熟悉的裂地者忽然集体参菌，顶着蘑菇头就燃了起来；
剧情中，大潘老师都忍不住吐槽，裂地者感染孢子后说话反而变利索了
而正经的研究者，也会一边和管理员严肃沟通工作，一边抱着块约有一洛茜高的大饼狂啃。
再比如， 你有没有想过，小刻是从哪凭空变出蜜饼来的？物理还存在吗？
还有，你可能听说过社群里“天有烘炉被驮兽粪便堵塞”的传说，但你见过“天有烘炉”爆饼吗？
很多时候，我都不知道到底要怎么形容眼前究竟在发生什蘑，只是一味地庆幸文章可以配图，不然光看文字，大概会让人觉得作者的精神状态很美妙。
至于为什么这篇文章会出现已达致死量的谐音梗——请抬头看看版本名中“甚大蘑境”四个大字，这点“归咎”于终末地一点也不冤。
在这个版本里，玩家不仅两步就能踩到一个蘑菇，也处处都能发现谐音梗：例如揍人的蘑菇人，大名叫做储菌；之前的碾骨氏族，也改头换面变成了碾菇氏族。
如同一些弱智吧段子，令人忍菌不禁
最让人敬佩的是，这种将蘑幻贯彻到底（我保证这是全文倒数第二处谐音梗）的精神，渗透到了这个版本中的边边角角。
开幕经典的“大白字”标题，这次就带上了重影。

进入2026年12月，游戏博物馆将持续给观众和玩家朋友们带来各种展览、活动。
位于上海市徐汇区的中国音数协游戏博物馆，是目前国内规模最大的专业电子游戏博物馆。馆内收藏游戏机、电脑、软件、书刊等实物逾 18000 件，设置有常设展区与主题展区，展览面积约 1500 m²。
其中常设展展出约 1100 件藏品，分为“电子游戏的起源”“主机游戏的兴起”“电脑游戏的繁荣”“中国游戏的发展”四部分；主题展区不定期举办各类游戏相关主题展览和互动活动。
目前，游戏博物馆已正式面向公众开放，观众可提前通过本公众号预约，或现场购票参观。进入 2026 年 12 月，游戏博物馆也将持续给观众和玩家朋友们带来各种展览、活动。
12月初，中国音数协游戏博物馆将上线语音导览； 12月6日，玩无极限——PlayStation无障碍电竞友谊赛将在中国音数协游戏博物馆举办； 12月18日 - 12月20日，中国音数协游戏博物馆将参展星图游戏嘉年华。
语音导览服务上线
12月初
中国音数协游戏博物馆常设展区语音导览服务将于 12 月初正式上线。首期导览以「电子游戏历史上的“纪念碑”——小展品承载大历史」为主题，涵盖常设展区内的 30 件代表性展品，带领观众从一件件展品出发，探寻其背后的历史与故事。
导览内容经多方资料查证与梳理，从博物馆的视角出发，讲述每件展品在电子游戏发展历程中的独特地位与历史意义，为观众提供更加深入、丰富的参观体验。
参观过程中，您可通过微信扫描展品旁的二维码购买相应的语音导览，也可选择阅读文字版内容。导览采用一次购买、不限次收听的形式，离馆后仍可通过小程序重温导览内容，具体价格请以展区内标识为准。
为共同维护良好的观展环境，建议您佩戴耳机收听。
本期语音导览由博物馆志愿者参与录制，在此向他们的辛勤付出致以诚挚的感谢。

items.title: 话题：《时之笛》彻底改变了 3D 剑战，但重制版在刀锋交锋的复古年份中表现如何？
items.summary: Finding the cutting edge of sword combat. Forget the hubbub around Grand Theft Auto . Big Walk ? Big deal. It’

content.v: Finding the cutting edge of sword combat.

Forget the hubbub around Grand Theft Auto . Big Walk ? Big deal. It’s all noise designed to distract us from 2026’s real legacy: that it’s been one of the best years on record for video game swordfighting.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword broke free of parryslop with exciting, flexible and immensely satisfying katana combat. Blood of Dawnwalker ’s directional combat recreated a scintillating sense of strike-and-counterstrike rhythm rather than asking players to hide behind defensive blocks. Then Phantom Blade Zero swans in with cinematic style and a dazzling flurry of wuxia sword strikes and somersaults.
